integrity: The all-copula result is an analytic conditional-Jensen theorem. Exact-rational checks support only the explicit absolutely continuous checkerboard family; no external proof certification or independent priority verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result fixes eta=0 and a uniform rank response, and does not determine the positive-eta region. The previously published singular endpoint is credited, not claimed as new. One antecedent on directed dependence was unavailable in full text. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: The sharp zero-regression boundary for Chatterjee rank dependence
